title: Contracted katakana: B and P rows — find the form
description: Use a Latin-letter spelling cue and base sign to distinguish small ャ/ュ/ョ from full-sized kana.

exercises.prompt: Which katakana spelling uses the ビ base sign + small ya (bya)? Compare small and full-sized kana.
exercises.explanation: ビャ is the contracted bya spelling. Small ャ joins ビ; ビヤ uses full-sized ヤ. These written forms are not interchangeable.

text.translation: Katakana bya: Small ャ joins ビ; ビヤ uses full-sized ヤ.
